description: Bestevaerstraat 1924-26 stair blocks (12 m pands holding two stair halves): four storeys of yellow-brown brick under a flat parapet, four symmetric axes (narrow, wide, wide, narrow) per block, glass-brick pilasters at the party walls, a dark plinth with an arched stair door

match.note: Bestevaerstraat 98-213: BAG 1924-26 pands of 11-13.5 m, 3DBAG eaves 12.3-13.0, bouwlagen 4-5 flat

parapet.note: Bestevaerstraat 141-213 strip 2024-11 gridded 1 m: yellow-brown brick wall to a flat parapet top at about 13.7 m over the top-storey windows (heads 11.4 m); flat roof behind; 3DBAG eaves 12.4-13.0 m

door-left.note: arched stair door (1.1 m, 0-2.3 m) at the party-wall pilaster, a dark brick plinth to 2.6 m with small paired ground windows (1.0-2.2 m); mirrored when the strip reads the door on the right

roof.evidence: Bestevaerstraat strips: sky directly over the parapet along the row

rhythm.bays: four axes per 12 m block, symmetric about the block centre
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: arched door + small windows | 1-3: 4 casements (narrow, wide, wide, narrow)
rhythm.symmetry: mirror about the block centre; glass-brick pilasters at the party walls
rhythm.groundFloor: dark brick plinth, arched stair door at the pilaster
